title: Craftable Saddle's
body:
Tired of relying on dungeon loot for saddles?

Craftable Saddles introduces a simple progression system by adding a new item: Rope.

🧵 Rope is crafted using leather and a stick, and is used to create saddles in a more immersive and balanced way.

🐎 Saddle Recipe:

2 Rope (left and right sides)
3 Leather across the top

🔧 Features:

Adds a new Rope item
Balanced saddle crafting recipe
Fits naturally into vanilla survival progression
Lightweight and modpack-friendly

🧪 Built for NeoForge 1.21.1

Perfect for players who want a more natural way to obtain saddles without relying on RNG.
